$comment: SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-2.0-only. The per-case record emitted by oracle.tcl and consumed by model/feature/occtparity/record.go. One file per OCCT tests/blend case.
title: OCCT blend-parity oracle record

verb.description: Which blend command drove the case; "" when the case never blended (e.g. a TODO stub).

expectedArea.description: OCCT's reference surface area from `checkprops -s`. 0 for TODO cases (checkprops -s 0).

deps.description: Relative tolerance from `checkprops -deps`, else 0.01 (OCCT's checkprops default).

todo.description: OCCT's own TODO/INCOMPLETE marker line if the case carries one, else "". Mirrored so we are never stricter than OCCT.

inputStep.description: Filename (sibling of this JSON) of OCCT's exact input solid as STEP. For bfuseblend, the FUSED solid. "" when no input was captured.

picks.description: One entry per blended edge. For bfuseblend, one per boolean-section edge (all same radius).

radius.description: Constant fillet radius (0 for variable-radius buildevol picks, which use `law`).

locator.description: Geometry-only edge locator = the edge's true mid-parameter point and unit tangent (OCCT's own curve evaluation), used to re-find the picked edge on our imported body.

law.description: Variable-radius law: the updatevol (parameter, radius) pairs. null for constant-radius picks.
